issues.text: Entered TEAM15 promo has no visible applied/error feedback, while the summary still shows a $0.00 discount.
Contact inputs lack accessible names: Organisation and Phone are exposed as unnamed textboxes.
Attendee name and Seats reserved controls are exposed as unnamed textbox/spinbutton.
Contact accepted the punctuation-only phone value '-------' and navigated to Attendees; no visible invalid-phone error was shown on Contact.
Attendees accepted fractional Seats reserved value 1.5 and navigated to Payment instead of remaining on Attendees with a whole-seat validation error.
Payment summary displays an invalid negative-zero discount value (“−$0.00”), which is misleading financial formatting.

A punctuation-only phone value such as ------- is rejected on Contact rather than allowing progression. — After submitting `-------` in step 46, the run proceeds to attendee entry: step 48 observes the Attendees controls (attendee name field and Standard ticket selector), demonstrating that the invalid phone did not keep the user on Contact.
Validation error insertion shifts the Notifications card downward after submitting blank required fields, contrary to the required stable layout.
Account settings save confirmation is shown, but all five settings revert to defaults after reloading: profile and delivery-note fields are blank and email digest resets from Weekly to Daily.
Validation error for Full name is placed below the unrelated Company field, disconnecting it from its input.
After Full name is populated, its “Full name is required.” validation error remains visible.

All entered settings persist after reloading: Full name Avery Chen, email avery.chen@example.test, company Northstar Logistics, Weekly digest, and delivery notes “Leave packages at the north reception — The fields were populated before saving (steps 3-7), but the fresh post-reload observation reports blank Full name, Email address, Company, and Delivery notes fields and Email digest reset to Daily rather than the selected Weekly value (step 9).

Saved account settings are lost on page reload. After saving name "Ada Lovelace", email "ada@example.com", company "Analytical Engines", digest "Weekly", and notes "Call before delivery", reloading re
Valid email value still displays an invalid-email error, leaving stale validation feedback.
Saved confirmation remains visible while later edits are unsaved, misleading users about current state.

After saving the entered name, email, company, Weekly digest, and delivery notes, all five saved settings remain unchanged after reload. — Before save, step 10 observed the requested five values in the controls, but step 12 observed that after reload all saved persistence-test fields were reset and the digest was Daily rather than Weekly.
Card validation error remains visible after the card field shows a valid 16-digit number, creating stale feedback.
Rapid double-click created two orders (BK-1001 and BK-1002); intended behavior is exactly one receipt/confirmation.

Repeated rapid activation of Place order creates exactly one order confirmation and one receipt, with no duplicate order. — The first valid order was BK-1001 (Step 4), but Step 6 reports the prior status as “Order BK-1002 confirmed.” and the final observation in Step 11 confirms exactly two receipts, BK-1001 and BK-1002.

The immediate second Place order click created a second buyer receipt: the status changed to “Order BK-1003 confirmed.” and Orders placed lists both BK-1002 — $1002.90 to buyer@example.com and BK-1003
Invalid billing email “@” is visibly accepted: green confirmation is shown instead of invalid-email feedback.
Intended visible Processing feedback never appears; submission transitions directly to “Order BK-1001 confirmed.”

Clicking Place order twice immediately for buyer@example.com with card 4111 1111 1111 1111 creates exactly one receipt and one confirmation. — After the first click, step 5 observes “Order BK-1002 confirmed.” and two receipts; after the second click, step 6 observes a second new confirmation, “Order BK-1003 confirmed.”, and three receipts total.

Submitting an unchanged order with billing email exactly “@” shows invalid-email feedback and creates no receipt. — After entering “@” and clicking Place order, step 7 observes that the prior “Order BK-1003 confirmed.” remains and the receipt list remains at three, but records no invalid-email feedback in the status area.

Applying High priority, Open only, and an “invoice” subject search leaves only “Invoice total looks wrong” and reports “Showing 1 of 8 tickets.” — After the search-fill action in step 7, the recorded table still has two visible open rows, “Cannot reset password” and “Invoice total looks wrong,” rather than only the invoice ticket.
After a filter change, the old bulk-close success toast remains instead of clearing as intended.
Clicking the primary fixed-bar Send to stakeholders button leaves the report unchanged and shows no visible confirmation that the report was sent.
Clicking Export CSV leaves the weekly report at the same URL with no visible browser download indication, CSV result, alert, confirmation, or other export feedback.

Clicking “Send to stakeholders” shows a visible confirmation that the report was sent while leaving the page usable. — Step 1 performed the Send to stakeholders click, but the trace records no resulting confirmation, navigation, DOM change, or other observed feedback.

Clicking “Export CSV” produces a CSV download or another visible export result rather than only a generic alert. — Step 2 clicked Export CSV and recorded domChanged=NO, with no download or browser export response observed.
Export CSV and Send to stakeholders did not present observable required confirmations after direct clicks: expected “Export queued.” and “Report sent.” respectively.
Clicking Export CSV displays the confirmation “Export queued.” — Step 2 clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO, and Step 3 explicitly observed that no Export CSV confirmation was visible.
Clicking Send to stakeholders displays the confirmation “Report sent.” — Step 3 clicked Send to stakeholders with domChanged=NO and recorded no observed confirmation or other effect from the click.
Stale insufficient-stock error remains visible after a successful Cable shipment is logged.
Quantity control has no accessible name; navigator exposes it as an unnamed spinbutton despite visible label.

For Washer 11mm, entering the requested received quantity of 3 works before recording the adjustment. — Step 12 directly fills the quantity spinbutton after Washer 11mm becomes selected, but records domChanged=NO and observes that Quantity still shows 1 rather than 3.

Clicking Reset counts resets the audit without incorrectly submitting it or opening a submission confirmation dialog. — Step 8 directly clicked Reset counts and observed that it visibly opened an “Audit submitted” dialog, despite Reset counts being the action invoked.
Submission dialog is present in page content but not visually rendered, leaving its message and Close button inaccessible by pointer.
Clicking the dialog's Close button hides the submission dialog without changing table counts. — Step 1's Close-button click failed, with no recorded dismissal or resulting table state.

Pressing Escape hides the submission dialog without changing table counts. — Step 3 records that Escape produced no visible change and the dialog continued to be exposed, while counts remained 140, 60, 18, and 7.

Clicking Washer 11mm's plus stepper once changes its Counted value from 60 to 61 and its Variance from an em dash to +1. — Steps 6, 8, and 11 all record Washer remaining at Counted 60 with an em-dash variance; steps 8 and 11 instead changed Hex bolt M4 to 141 with +1.
